d:
Nitish Setu ke udghatan samaroh men PM Modi ne apne sanbodhan ke dauran bihar ke badlav aur vikas ka jikr kiya. unhonne kaha ki pahle bihar men apradh ki charcha hoti thi, lekin ab rajy men vikas ki bat ho rahi hai. dekhie PM Modi ke bhashan ka yah khas vidiyo.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
